text: You are right. In Harmonize your permission to push main was already given (CLAUDE.md, 2026-11-09), but the kit's install (11-20) wrote trunk_push off without reading it. The kit repo was installed on 11-22 the same way. So nothing was switched off later: the installer ignored a permission you had already given. Fix, as a small kit part after the merges: the installer and --update keep any permission already given (trunk push, auto mode, others) and ask only when none exists, with a test.
